The US sent a School Bus load of Soldiers to assure the Philippines that it has not Abandoned them!

The Pentagon has just dispatched 50 soldiers to the Philippines. Fifty. That’s about the size of a school bus. Yet Washington insists this is a “new presence” meant to contain China. If this is containment, it’s more symbolic than strategic—like waving a pocketknife at a tank.

The Philippines, bless it's archipelagic geography, sits on the Ring of Fire. Earthquakes, typhoons, and volcanoes are its natural inheritance. Strategic depth? None. Any base there is a sitting duck for Chinese missiles. Fifty men won’t change that equation. They’re not a fighting force; they’re a flag planted in borrowed soil.

So why bother? Because symbolism is cheap and the Filipinos are brainwashed. Every Filipino child grew up wanting to migrate to America because they believe the Americans liberated the Filipinos from the Spanish, the Japanese and then from themselves!

The 50 soldiers reassure Manila that Uncle Sam hasn’t forgotten it. It signals to Beijing that America can still show up in its neighborhood by sending second grade soldiers. In short, it’s theatre—deterrence by optics inspite of the fact that the US Navy will be half the size of the Chinese Navy by 2035 due to the US lacking in skilled manpower, modern manufacturing and shipbuilding capabilities and resilient supply chain.

But let’s not confuse theatre with warfighting. In a real conflict, those 50 soldiers would be evacuated before the first missile strike as the US Navy will not survive a war with China in the West Pacific. Their presence is a message, not a military plan. The balance of power in the West Pacific remains unchanged. 

The Philippines is a developing country that makes  most of its money from inbound remittances from Filipinos working overseas as maids, nurses or seamen - but the pot of gold in Philippines is the public work budget as every crooked politicians know in the Philippines.

The US may be playing chess, but in the Philippines, it’s moving pawns for show as it knows what matters to the political elites in Manila is they can continue to allocate the public work budget such as flood control for the benefits of their cronies, and by painting China as an aggressor it create a smoke screen for the crooked politicians.

1/2
